# DrAppIcon

> DrAppIcon is a free web tool that turns a single image into a complete, store-ready app icon set for iOS and Android. It runs entirely in the visitor's browser — no uploads, no accounts, no watermarks.

Key facts:
- Input: one PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP image (up to 10 MB; 1024x1024 or larger recommended).
- iOS output: AppIcon.appiconset with all 18 sizes including the 1024 px App Store icon, plus a ready-made Contents.json.
- Android output: legacy and round launcher icons for ldpi (36 px) through xxxhdpi (192 px) in PNG or WebP; adaptive icon foregrounds (108-432 px), an optional monochrome layer for themed icons, mipmap-anydpi-v26 XML descriptors, a background colour resource, the 512 px Play Store icon and a web icon.
- Customization: background colour (auto-picked from the artwork's dominant colour), size (padding/zoom), badge text, monochrome artwork, custom icon file name.
- Privacy: generation happens on a canvas in the browser tab; images never leave the device.
- Price: free.
- Maker: Dusrel, an independent one-person studio. Contact: support@drappicon.dusrel.com.
